The composition of Board was not in compliance due to non-availability of requisite number of Independent Directors on the Board of REC. The Company will be in compliance, once the requisite number of Independent Directors are appointed by the administrative ministry i.e. MoP, Government of India.

This composition of Audit Committee is the best available independent composition considering the availaibility of Independent Directors as there is only one Independent Director available on the Board of the Company.
For Point no. V (3), The present composition of Nomination and Remuneration Committee comprised of one Independent Director and two Nominee (Non-executive) Directors. This composition of Nomination and Remuneration Committee is the best available independent composition considering the availaibility of Independent Directors as there is only one Independent Director available on the Board of the Company.
